defects.title: MF-02 Profiles chosen in the Create Module dialog are not applied
defects.actual: The dialog sends PUT /modules/{id}/permissions → 404 with no error; a module meant for Desk Administrator only is listed, readable and writable by Desk Agents.

defects.title: MF-10 A required field can be set to "Don't Show"
defects.actual: Required Name set to Don't Show for Desk Agent is saved; agents then get 422 "not writable for your profile" on every create.

defects.title: MF-11 Access Control picker lists CRM users and profiles instead of Desk ones
defects.actual: Picker loads /iam/users?app_key=crm; Profiles shows CRM Admin, Manager, Supervisor, test, User; Desk agent not found. Layouts/modules cannot be limited to Desk profiles from the UI.

defects.title: MF-33 Field dependency rules (SHOW / REQUIRE) are saved but not applied
defects.actual: Rules are stored and listed, but the form ignores them (hidden field shown, required field not required) and the record API accepts records that break them.

defects.title: MF-34 Conditional visibility is not applied on the record form
defects.actual: A field set to show only when ctrl = "x" is shown and required when ctrl = Z.

defects.title: MF-35 Department storage has no effect on records
defects.actual: Department-storage modules store records without a department; every user sees every record; department header/body ignored.

defects.title: MF-36 File and image upload restrictions are not enforced
defects.actual: PDF-only 1 MB field accepts .txt, .png and a 2.2 MB file with no message; the record API accepts any file object.

defects.title: MF-37 Radio and Status fields accept values that are not in their list
defects.actual: Radio "R9" and status "Nope" saved (201) and shown as a status chip. Same family as MF-08.

defects.title: MF-38 Deleted dependency rules come back after Save
defects.actual: Deleting all rules shows "No dependency rules yet", but after Save Rules + Save the 2 rules are still stored.

defects.title: MF-39 Custom data types are listed but cannot be used to create a field (API)
defects.actual: New custom type appears in GET /fields/datatypes; POST field with that key → 400 DATATYPE_KEY_UNKNOWN.

defects.title: MF-40 Record API stores values for fields that do not exist
defects.actual: Records created with qa_* keys before the fields existed returned 201 and kept the values; when the field was later created as unique, those hidden values counted as duplicates (422).

defects.title: MF-46 Recycle Bin "Delete forever" fails for every Desk item with no message
defects.actual: UI and API: POST /audit/recycle-bin/delete → 200 with failed[] reason "recyclebin.error.unsupported_app"; the page shows no error and the item stays. Desk items can only expire after 60 days.

defects.title: MF-41 The 512-fields-per-layout limit is not enforced by the API
defects.actual: UI says "Maximum of 512 fields per layout reached", but PUT layout with 550 fields → 200.

defects.title: MF-42 Rollup summary accepts a relation that does not point at the module
defects.actual: Rollup on QA MF DeptMod over QA MF Types.qa_lk (which points at QA MF Open) → 201; rollups were also accepted before the lookup field existed.

defects.title: MF-43 Layout API accepts Required + Read-only on the same field
defects.actual: The builder blocks it, but PUT layout with required:true and read_only:true → 200.

defects.title: MF-44 Auto-fill "Another field on this form" offers only system fields
defects.actual: Options: Name, Created By, Modified By, Created Time, Modified Time — custom fields on the form are not offered.

defects.title: MF-45 Quick-create trigger dialog shows a raw "{{module}}" placeholder
defects.actual: "This {{module}} is created only after you save the record…"
